annotations.title: Top gainers/losers reported in the news ('#TICKER = ±X%')

description:
Top gainers/losers reported in the news ('#TICKER = ±X%'). Parses '#TICKER [Name] = ±X%' price-move mentions (stocks, indices, crypto; RU/US/... from the flag) in news of the last N hours (1-72, default 6), newest mention per ticker, |move| >= min_pct (default 0): top 10 gainers and top 10 losers with the source item.

GET /news/movers — price $0.005 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 6, clamped to 1-72) Default: 6.

min_pct.description: Minimum absolute move in percent (default 0, max 100), e.g. 3 or 2.5 Default: 0.

name: get_news_movers
title: Top gainers/losers reported in the news ('#TICKER = ±X%')
